notes: 2.3.6 The highest number of female suicides which was on account of ‘Dreadfu!
Disease’ rose by 21.8 per cent during the last 5 years. The suicide on account of ‘Dowry
Dispute’also rose in the same proportion during this period. ‘Dowry’ which was orginally
a wedding gift to a daughter from her family has become a source of exploitation &
abuse with the passage of time. Suicides on account of failure in love affairs have also
increased by 53 per cent in this period. Female deaths due to unemployment has
reported a declining trend. The reason may be due to the increased employment
opportunity and reservation for women in employment in various government jobs.
